integrity: A complete all-odd-degree polynomial-coordinate argument supplies the result. Finite exact tests are corroborative, not exhaustive. Previous low-degree calculations and the literature foundations are credited; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Proved over the complex numbers for the reduced union of two affine composition components at odd indices at least five. Full invariant reducibility only identified when the odd index is prime. No assertion about nonreduced resultant/Jacobian schemes, projective compactifications, or other composition components.
title: Global coordinate straightening and the Cohen–Macaulay threshold for two polynomial-composition loci
